scenes.title: Stevin Structural Testing Hall
scenes.institution: Delft University of Technology — Macrolab / Stevinlaboratory structural test hall
scenes.reference_notes: Official hall photograph shows long white concrete beam specimens passing through large blue bolted steel loading frames. Supported hydraulic cylinders contact the beams; many surface sensor leads feed local acquisition desks. Tripod cameras and yellow/red movable barriers border the test area; red fixture frames stand along the back wall. High glazing, an overhead crane beam and an upper gallery establish the industrial hall context. Photo identifies a particular structural-test setup, not the permanent placement of every hall fixture. Exact beam dimensions, hidden doorways, specimen reinforcement and damage state are not measured. A reconstruction may support fixture access and sample positioning; concrete fracture and structural response require separate validated models. Image CDN is embedded by the official university page.

scenes.title: Robotic Fabrication Gantry Hall
scenes.institution: ETH Zurich — Robotic Fabrication Laboratory at Arch_Tec_Lab
scenes.reference_notes: Official photograph identifies the Robotic Fabrication Laboratory and shows multiple industrial manipulators hanging from tall gantry carriages. White overhead rail frames and vertical lift members support the robot bases; cable chains follow the travel axes. Double-height work floor is surrounded by upper glazed rooms, a rear staircase and full-height side windows; yellow safety posts mark the work zone. The photograph documents real installed hardware but not a running fabrication sequence. Gantry span, robot models, control performance and hidden hall boundaries require further evidence. No structural fabrication or material-process validation is implied.

scenes.title: FloWave Circular Ocean Research Basin
scenes.institution: The University of Edinburgh — FloWave Ocean Energy Research Facility
scenes.reference_notes: Official photographs show narrow framed flaps, genuinely open annular metal grating, yellow rim services, navy peripheral lattice, white control cabinets and a yellow overhead crane. Official dimensions distinguish the 30 m diameter / 5 m deep outer shell from the 25 m diameter / 2 m deep upper test region. The 2026 primary paper identifies 168 flap-type wavemakers with hinges 1.7 m below water. Room, freeboard, section sizes and services remain estimates; no water dynamics or OEM transmission is reconstructed.
observed_cues: Official photographs show narrow framed flaps, genuinely open annular metal grating, yellow rim services, navy peripheral lattice, white control cabinets and a yellow overhead crane. Official dimensions distinguish the 30 m diameter / 5 m deep outer shell from the 25 m diameter / 2 m deep upper test region. The 2026 primary paper identifies 168 flap-type wavemakers with hinges 1.7 m below water. Room, freeboard, section sizes and services remain estimates; no water dynamics or OEM transmission is reconstructed.

equipment.role: 168 independently hinged mechanical flaps around a 25 m circular test region
equipment.evidence: Published count, upper test dimensions and hinge depth; photo-informed frame and open grating, with explicitly estimated angular range, sections and drives.

support.evidence: Floor datum z=0; outer shell floor top z=-5.0 m, underside rests on foundation top z=-5.2 m. Authored support columns and fixed inspection locks carry hinge ring and raised test floor. Floor-lifting system is absent.

task.name: Inspect the complete 168-flap positioning array
task.description: Command bounded coordinated hinge positions and physically return the whole array. Every flap has contact geometry. Static optical water remains present, but no waves, currents, active absorption or hydrodynamic loads are generated.
task.observable: 168 measured hinge angles in radians, actual top-edge positions and mechanical clearances

reserved_walkways.basis: Authored clear circulation route; not a surveyed route or building-code certification
Authored clear circulation route; not a surveyed route or building-code certification

layout_rationale: Published 30 m / 5 m shell is distinct from the 25 m / 2 m upper test region. Deck datum, 350 mm freeboard and fixed raised-floor support state are authored.
Open grating has finite bars and real holes, supported by annular/radial beams and columns reaching the basin floor. Pitch and sections are estimates.
Yellow rim services, navy lattice, white cabinets, pressure-vessel exteriors and yellow bridge crane follow actual official photos; hidden service workings are not claimed.
Version 2 replaces two translating representative boards with all 168 hinged flaps. Old paddle_west/paddle_east actions are rejected, not silently converted.
limitations: Reference-informed selected facility subset; unseen room boundaries and dimensions are estimates, not a surveyed or institution-validated twin.
Original procedural geometry; no OEM CAD downloaded and no source photographs embedded.
Institution names identify visual references; redistribution permission and endorsement have not been obtained.
Mechanical access and positioning only; scientific process accuracy and complete autonomous experiments remain unvalidated.
Water is a fixed optical volume with no fluid mass, waves, currents, turbulence, buoyancy, splashes or hydrodynamic forces.
Published count/dimensions/hinge depth are source anchors. The 405 mm panels, angular range ±0.12 rad, sections, mass, ideal gravity compensation and servo properties are authored estimates.
Inter-panel gaps are real and unsealed; this dry geometric array is not a watertight wavemaker boundary or calibrated experimental controller.
The raised test floor is locked on disclosed authored supports. Its real floor lifting/buoyancy system, bellows transmission and 28 operational circulation impellers are not modeled.
Optical volume covers the upper test region; hidden return-plenum liquid/flow and suspended gantry operation remain absent.
Full-array physics is slower than real time on the measured single-CPU setup; checked-operation performance is reported separately.
